content.en: Researchers have been investigating the use of deep learning algorithms to improve the detection of phishing attacks. They have developed various models, such as Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), to detect phishing URLs and websites. These algorithms show promise in improving accuracy and reducing false positives in phishing detection systems.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af deep learning-algoritmer til at forbedre detektion af phishingangreb. De har udviklet forskellige modeller, såsom Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) og Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), til at detektere phishing-URLs og -websites. Disse algoritmer viser lovende resultater i at forbedre nøjagtigheden og reducere falske positiver i phishingdetektionssystemer.

critic.en: You're telling me that "Deep Phishing" is the hero we've been waiting for? The same AI innovation that enables more sophisticated deception is now our savior from it? Let's not lose sight of the fact that phishing detection is a race with the criminals, and they are already leveraging AI to create more advanced and elusive scams.
critic.da: Ah, så vi skal bare stole på, at AI’en kan redde os fra phishing?

potential.en: This is fascinating! Do you think that this technology is mature enough to be implemented in real-world applications, or is more research and development needed?
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan AI bruges til at styrke cybersikkerheden! Phishingangreb er en så stor trussel, og med maskinlæring kan vi forhåbentlig beskytte folk bedre. Jeg synes, det er spændende at lære om de forskellige typer af neurale netværk, der bliver brugt. Hvilken model tror du har størst potentiale i praksis?
